title: In 1917, 19 Hidden Mines Blew at Once and London Heard It

scenes.text: In 1917, 19 underground bombs went off at once, and London heard it.
For months, tunnellers dug beneath German lines at Messines Ridge.
They packed 19 chambers with nearly one million pounds of explosives.
At 3:10 in the morning on June 7, 1917, the mines were fired.
The ground heaved like an earthquake. The blast was reportedly heard in London, about 130 miles away.
As many as 10,000 soldiers were killed in minutes.
It was the biggest planned explosion in history until the atomic bomb.

description:
In 1917, 19 underground mines went off at once at Messines Ridge.
Nearly one million pounds of explosives. The blast was reportedly heard in London, 130 miles away.
What's the loudest thing you've ever heard?
